newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Bad weather brings Bulgaria president to Romania.
newsitem.headline: Bad weather brings Bulgaria president to Romania.

text.p: Romanian President Emil Constantinescu had an unexpected guest on Thursday when bad weather forced an airliner carrying Bulgarian President Petar Stoyanov to land in Bucharest.
Stoyanov was returning to Sofia after an official visit to Italy but a blizzard shut the airport in the Bulgarian capital.
Constantinescu and Stoyanov met briefly in the Cotroceni presidential palace. Eventually, Stoyanov and his entourage drove off to neigbouring Bulgaria in cars offered by the Romanian authorities.
